summary: Four-legged steel lookout, about 120 ft (36.6 m) high, about 3 miles NNE of Dierks in Howard County, AR; first surveyed in 1951. Build date and present condition not found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with an observation cabin on top

events.note: First observed by the Coast and Geodetic Survey; the station description gives a four-legged steel tower about 120 feet high with an observation cabin on top

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing, access or present status found in the sources read. The record's location (34.162, -94.0017) is under 100 m from the NGS published position (about 34.1615, -94.0022); not treated as an error. A search snippet for a Facebook post in the U.S. Forest Service Lookouts group (post 10160174514172543) says the tower appears on a 1935 Arkansas Forestry Commission map. The post would not open, so the claim is unverified and not used; a 1930s AFC or state map could date the build. The NGS datasheet shows no destroyed mark, but that does not confirm the tower stands; a site check is needed before any status or access is stated.
